rules.statement: A sub-tenant is bound by a decree for ejectment entered against the tenant and it is the duty of the Fiscal to remove the sub-tenant as he is a person bound by the decree and deliver possession to the landlord.
rules.supporting_quote: "A decree in ejectment passed against a lessee at the instance of a lessor is not only binding upon the lessee but also upon his subtenants provided they have no right independent of the right of their lessor in the demised premises."
